blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The EcoWaste Coalition has called on the Philippine National Police (PNP) to immediately release protesters arrested during demonstrations held alongside the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, while urging the Commission on Human Rights (CHR) to investigate reports of mass arrests and alleged police abuses. In a statement Wednesday, the environmental health and justice group denounced what it described as the arbitrary and warrantless arrests of hundreds of people, including student activists, campus journalists and environmental defenders, during protest actions in Makati, Manila and Muntinlupa.
